The role leads commercial strategy, sales and business development, financial performance, operations, supply chain, customer relationships, and people leadership to drive sustainable and profitable growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Develop and execute the annual business plan, commercial strategy, and growth initiatives in alignment with Group strategy. Establish and achieve annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue, gross profit, profitability, and business growth targets. Lead the overall sales and business development strategy, including key accounts, sales channels, customer acquisition, and market expansion. Build and maintain strong relationships with developers, architects, interior designers, contractors, construction companies, furniture manufacturers, hospitality projects, property owners, investors, and other strategic clients. Identify new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, customer segments, products, and channels to drive sustainable business growth. Develop and monitor pricing, commercial terms, product mix, and project margins to ensure competitiveness and profitability. Manage the overall P&L and financial performance, including revenue, gross profit, operating expenses, cash flow, working capital, and profitability. Work closely with Finance to manage customer credit, accounts receivable, collections, and financial risks. Oversee suppliers, procurement, imports, logistics, customs clearance, inventory, and warehouse operations to ensure product availability and cost efficiency. Work with suppliers to identify and develop new products, designs, finishes, and materials based on market demand and business opportunities. Establish and improve SOPs, internal controls, and operational processes while identifying and resolving business and operational issues. Establish clear organizational responsibilities, KPIs, and performance expectations while building a high-performance and accountable team. Develop talent, strengthen management capabilities, and identify succession opportunities for key positions. Review business performance against targets and budget, identify gaps, and implement timely corrective actions. Provide regular business performance reports, strategic recommendations, and key business updates to the CEO / MD. QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Interior Design, Construction, or a related field; Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. Minimum 8 years of progressive management experience, preferably with experience leading a sales, commercial, operational, or P&L-driven business. Experience in premium wood products, decorative materials, building materials, interior products, furniture, construction, or related industries is highly preferred. Proven track record of achieving revenue growth, gross profit, and business performance targets. Strong understanding of B2B, project-based, specification-driven, and channel sales. Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and business development capability. Strong financial and P&L management understanding, including revenue, gross profit, cost control, and cash flow. Excellent leadership, people management, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and execution capabilities. Strong ownership and accountability for business results, with the ability to translate strategic objectives into actionable plans and build high-performing teams.

This is a hands-on executive leadership role spanning strategic financial advice and day-to-day financial systems and operations. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, you will advise the Chief Executive and Board, strengthen financial performance and assurance, and ensure finance supports informed decisions, organisational sustainability and positive outcomes for whānau. Key responsibilities and outcomes include: ·       Provide strategic financial and investment advice to the Chief Executive and Board, and lead budgeting and forecasting. ·       Lead finance operations and maintain strong, accurate payroll, accounting, audit and financial control systems. ·       Assess financial viability across projects, programmes, property and commercial acquisitions, and manage investments, assets and financial risk. ·       Provide governance assurance through high-quality financial reporting, regulatory compliance, robust records and proactive risk management. ·       Lead and develop a high-performing finance team and create clear line of sight between their mahi, organisational priorities and whānau outcomes. ·       Build strong relationships with the Board, government agencies, iwi, hapū, marae, funders and other stakeholders. ·       Oversee contracting and procurement activity to support affordability and value for money. ·       Apply Te Tiriti o Waitangi in finance policy, practice and decision-making. Ngā hua mō te whānau | Whānau outcomes Strong financial stewardship enables He Herenga Kura to sustain housing and social support services, invest responsibly and direct resources where they can make the greatest difference for whānau. This role contributes to all four whānau outcomes: ·       Whānau live in safe, healthy and affordable homes. ·       Whānau confidently uptake pathways to secure and sustainable living. ·       Whānau living options meet their individual, collective and cultural needs. ·       Whānau are actively involved in community life. You will understand that good financial leadership in He Herenga Kura is ultimately about enabling sustainable outcomes for whānau. Chartered Accountant registration, or progress towards registration, is desirable. These uara guide how we work with one another and how we walk alongside whānau - strengthening connections, supporting wellbeing and helping create flourishing futures. review_candidates.title: General Manager - Research & Analytics
review_candidates.description: The GM Research & Analytics will build and lead TCF’s Research & Analytics Unit as the organization’s central hub for insight, evidence, and performance intelligence. The role will integrate research and data analytics to inform strategic choices, improve program effectiveness, and strengthen system-wide performance across one of the largest independent education networks in the world. This role sits at the intersection of education, research, and management within one of the largest and most complex education networks in the country. It will combine rigorous impact evaluation and applied research with advanced analytics to answer critical questions on learning, operations, and scale. The GM will also translate TCF’s experience into credible, high-quality knowledge products that contribute to the broader education ecosystem. About the Role The role has two primary objectives: Drive better decisions internally: Embed data, evidence, and analytics into leadership forums and day-to-day management across programs and functions. Advance system-level learning and evidence externally: Generate and contribute rigorous insights on what works in education at scale, drawing on TCF’s experience to inform the broader education ecosystem. Responsibilities Define and lead TCF’s research, evaluation, and learning agenda aligned to organizational priorities, strategic questions, and long-term impact goals. Develop and operationalize organization-wide impact measurement frameworks covering learning outcomes, operational effectiveness, and long-term life outcomes across programs. Lead and commission research studies, evaluations, pilots, and innovation initiatives to identify “what works” and support evidence-based program design, continuous improvement, and scale/stop decisions. Serve as TCF’s interface with the broader research and policy ecosystem, synthesizing global evidence and building partnerships with academic, policy, and development stakeholders. Produce high-quality knowledge products, evidence syntheses, and thought leadership to articulate TCF’s experience and contribute to system-level learning in education at scale. Develop and institutionalize organization-wide KPI frameworks, executive and board-level dashboards, reporting cadences, and performance analytics across programs and functions to identify trends, diagnose performance drivers, and support continuous improvement and decision-making. Partner with leadership teams to embed analytics and evidence into key decision-making forums, including Executive Team reviews, annual planning, and operational performance discussions, strengthening the organization’s ability to make timely, data-driven decisions through reliable data systems, analytical tools, and insight generation. Build advanced analytics and predictive capabilities to enable proactive interventions and resource allocation, including areas such as student risk, teacher retention, school performance, and program effectiveness. Partner closely with Tech & Transformation to strengthen data governance, integrity, and integration across core organizational data domains including students, teachers, schools, operations, and finance. Build and scale the Research & Analytics Unit as an enterprise-wide function integrating research, analytics, evaluation, and organizational learning capabilities, supported by clear governance structures, operating models, and prioritization mechanisms. Drive cross-functional collaboration with Programs, Finance, Development, and Tech & Transformation to strengthen integrated decision-making, pilot governance, and organization-wide performance improvement. Develop and lead a high-performing multidisciplinary team while building organizational capability in data literacy, evidence-based decision-making, and the effective use of analytics and research insights. Qualifications Master’s degree in Economics, Public Policy, Education, Data Analytics, Public or Business Administration or related field. Strong understanding of research methodologies and data analytics. Required Skills 10–15 years of relevant experience in program design and management, research, analytics, strategy, or impact evaluation. Exposure to the development sector and large-scale social impact programs is essential. An in-depth understanding of the education space would be preferred. Proven experience leading high-performing teams, driving cross-functional initiatives, managing senior stakeholders and representation on a national / global stage. Strong analytical and strategic thinking capability with expertise in data interpretation, performance tracking, and insight generation. Excellent communication and presentation skills for senior internal and external stakeholders. Leadership and stakeholder management across complex environments. Preferred Skills Experience in building and scaling research and analytics functions. Familiarity with advanced analytics tools and methodologies.
